title: Getting around the Art Museum
description: Photo walkthrough of the Welcome Cart, elevators, quiet space and restrooms. Pages 7–10 show the Great Hall restroom approach, Elevator A, the quiet space and ground-floor restrooms.

title: Quiet zones, restrooms and changing tables
description: Photos identify quiet rooms, restroom approaches and adult changing tables. Restroom and changing-table photos are on pages 8–11. The cover dates this guide May 26, 2023.

title: Inside the Main Library sensory room
description: All 20 PDF pages were visually reviewed. Photographs show the session timer (page 4), dimmer/projector switches (6), lit projector and bubble tubes (7 and 12), activity-wall controls (8), hammock and crash pad (9–10), low storage beneath benches (14–17), and an open door with lever handle beside the timer (19). The April 2023 PDF does not show the building entrance, elevator route to the second floor, toilets, door width or equipment limits, and does not guarantee today’s layout or availability. Staff portraits remain only in the original guide. Linked at the library; no reuse licence established.
documentDate: PDF created April 6, 2023; photo capture dates unstated

title: Arriving at the zoo
description: The 2025 guide mixes photographs and illustrations. Pages 3–7 show parking, the elevator/escalator, bridge, ticket building and entrance gates; pages 24–25 show restroom examples and changing equipment; pages 26–28 show seating, a calming room and quiet spaces. The file identifies some AI-generated content without saying which images. Photo dates are unknown. Use it for orientation, not to verify dimensions, equipment availability or a complete route.

title: Going to Newport Aquarium
description: One-page photo checklist showing the parking garage, elevator and stairs, aquarium entrance, security checks, ticket counter and elevator or escalator to exhibits. PDF metadata dates the file February 2020; photo dates are unknown. Confirm current routes and procedures with the aquarium.

title: Leaving Newport Aquarium
description: One-page photo checklist showing the exit doors, courtyard crossing and garage elevator beside stairs. PDF metadata dates the file February 2020; photo dates are unknown. These views do not establish a continuous step-free route or current elevator operation.

title: Aquatic Center frontage in the city visitor guide
description: Page 30 of the city’s 2025 visitor guide includes a photograph of the brick entrance frontage and paved forecourt, alongside pool and slide-area photographs. This is a tourism brochure, not an access-route walkthrough. These photos do not establish door-control details, a continuous parking-to-pool route or lift and transfer procedures. Photo dates are unknown.

title: TANK How to Ride brochure
description: Two-page folded brochure, revised May 2025, with photographs of passengers waiting beside a bus and a hand using the fare reader on page 1; page 2 includes passengers near a bus doorway. It explains destination signs, stop announcements, the signal cord and front-seat priority. It is not a ramp, lift or station-route walkthrough. Photo dates are unknown; it predates the November 7, 2026 replacement of the Southbank Shuttle and Route 16, so use current timetables. The current FAQ also publishes a different reduced fare.

title: Mall entrance frontage in the city visitor guide
description: Page 15 of the city’s 2025 visitor guide includes a photograph of Florence Mall’s glass entrance frontage beneath a curved canopy, with planters, a bench and the paved forecourt. It is a tourism brochure, not an access-route walkthrough. The photograph does not establish which entrance to use, parking-to-door continuity, door controls, thresholds or current operation. Photo date is unknown.

title: Historical Transit Center photos (2017)
description: Page 13 of the Fall/Winter 2017 county publication carries TANK’s renovation article with photographs of the information booth, route-display board and a bus beside the raised boarding edge and Bay A sign. Photo dates are unknown. This is a historical overview, not a continuous access walkthrough or a current route guide. It predates the November 2026 service changes; confirm current bay assignments, routes, pavement, lighting, booth staffing and boarding arrangements with TANK.
publisher: TANK / What’s Happening! in Kenton County

title: Government Center in the 2026 polling-place photo guide
description: Page 20 shows the Government Center exterior, glazed entrance forecourt, interior display corridor and doorway to the Riedlin Schott Room. The election-specific instructions say to enter through the main front doors and use an elevator or steps to the second floor. Photo dates are unknown. The September 2026 file does not explain the construction approach, establish daily service access or current elevator operation, or confirm future polling arrangements. Read the county’s separate construction notice before travelling.

title: Covington library entrance in the 2026 polling photo guide
description: Page 5 shows two exterior photographs of Covington library, including the entrance canopy and glass doorway, beside a second-floor voting-room plan. Its election-specific text says to enter the main entrance and use steps or an elevator to the second-floor conference room behind the circulation desk. Photo dates are unknown. This is not a continuous access walkthrough, a current elevator-operation check or guidance for a future election; confirm daily library routes and opening separately.

title: Winton Lake launch photographs in the 2021 annual report
description: Pages 16–17 show the canoe/kayak launch opening and a larger view of the railed gangway, floating platform, boat-support hardware and a nearby bench. This historical annual report is not an access walkthrough or operating manual. The report describes a summer 2021 installation; individual photo dates are unknown. Confirm current equipment, lake conditions, assistance, opening times and the parking-to-launch route with Great Parks. No independent-transfer or current-operation guarantee is made.

title: Independence library entrance in the 2026 polling photo guide
description: Page 17 shows the brick and glass frontage, paved forecourt and bollards beside a plan of the circular meeting room. The election-specific text places the main entrance and parking behind the building and the voting room to the right. Photo date is unknown. This does not establish daily library access, door controls, thresholds, a continuous parking route or future voting arrangements; confirm current branch instructions separately.

title: Erlanger library in the 2026 polling photo guide
description: Page 12 combines an aerial photograph of the parking area and building, an exterior frontage photograph and a floor plan marking the front-door approach to the Bronte Room for the 2026 election. Photo capture dates are unknown. This is an election orientation page, not a ground-level access walkthrough or future voting instruction. It does not establish door controls, thresholds, restroom features, a continuous parking route or current construction and drive-through arrangements; check the branch’s separate notice.

title: Hub arrival photograph and map in the 2023 presentation
description: Page 14 pairs a photograph of the 911 Evans Street frontage with an aerial diagram pointing to the Woodrow Street parking entrance and the Hub doors on the right side. Page 6 has a small indoor warehouse photograph. Capture dates are unknown. This December 2023 presentation is a historical overview, not a current access walkthrough: it does not show a continuous parking-to-door route, threshold details, elevator controls, toilets or current operation. It predates the 2026 Hub Club program; use the venue’s current pages for prices, shop sales, accepted materials and instructions.
publisher: Cincinnati Recycling & Reuse Hub / Ohio EPA

title: Indoor track photograph — Summer 2026 guide
description: Page 17 includes a small photograph of the banked indoor walking/running track and its railings. Individual photo dates are not supplied. This general city activity guide does not show lift operation, a parking-to-door connection or current equipment availability; its pool schedule is for summer 2026.

title: Preparing for a group visit — 2023–24 photo narrative
description: Photo narrative for a group visit: the entrance is on page 3, front-desk check-in on page 5, restroom signage and an interior on page 11, the lobby beside elevator information on page 12, and stairs on page 13. Pages 18–19 show the lobby and coat bins. The filename says 2023–24; PDF metadata dates the file August 2023 and individual photo dates are unknown. Its exhibition names and page 20’s blanket free-admission statement are historical; use the current admission notes and confirm group arrangements. Photos do not establish dimensions or current operation.

title: Visitor guide: front steps photograph and floor plans
description: Four-page visitor brochure with a photograph of the historic house and front steps on page 1. Pages 3–4 are floor-plan diagrams, not photographs: their keys mark restrooms, diaper-changing stations, stairs, an elevator and a lift for which visitors should ask for assistance; the first-floor plan labels the quiet room and garage connection. The filename says 2025 and PDF metadata dates the file December 2024; individual photo dates are unknown. This is not a photographed arrival-route walkthrough or proof of current equipment operation.

title: Garage, entrance controls and museum arrival
description: Fifteen-page photo walkthrough. Pages 3–7 show a garage entrance, green-section elevator, plaza sign, the door beside the revolving entrance and its hand-wave control. Pages 8–14 show the lobby, check-in desk, restroom approach and gallery elevators. PDF metadata dates it October 10, 2023; individual photo dates are unknown. Confirm current routes and operation. Its restroom text mentions floors one and three; the current accessibility page also lists floor four. No adult-changing or continuous-route guarantee is established.

title: Dining seating, rentals and the two main elevators
description: Seven-page official guide dated May 26, 2023. Pages 3–5 show dining tables and an ordering kiosk, rental wheelchairs/strollers, and the Express and East Elevator doorways and signs. Individual photo dates are unknown. The pictured rental prices and cafe names are historical; current visitor-page sections disagree on the ECV fee ($27/$29). Confirm current charges, dining arrangements, allergy information and elevator operation. The guide does not establish clearances or a continuous route.

title: TANK Plus vehicle doorway in the 2025 FAQ
description: Page 3 shows a branded TANK Plus bus with its front door open, entrance steps and a handrail. The lift or ramp is not deployed and wheelchair securement is not shown. This five-page FAQ is a June 2025 revision by filename, with May 2025 PDF metadata; photo date is unknown. Its map predates the November 2026 service expansion. Page 4 describes capacity for two or three wheelchairs, while the current microtransit webpage says three; confirm the assigned vehicle and current arrangements. This is not a step-by-step boarding guide.

title: 2016 kayak-launch photograph in the annual report
description: PDF page 6 (printed pages 10–11) contains a small photograph beside the Miami Whitewater Forest launch article, showing the dock, transfer bench and rails. The report describes completion in April 2016; PDF metadata dates the document March 6, 2017, and the individual photo date is unknown. This is a historical annual report, not an arrival walkthrough. It does not show the complete parking-to-launch route or establish present equipment operation, dimensions or assistance. Other pages discuss different parks and historical programs and prices.

title: Sensory pre-visit narrative: doors, elevator and restroom approaches
description: Eighteen-page photo narrative linked from the sensory-friendly performance page. Page 2 shows the front doors; pages 4–6 show lobby seating, the hallway to the elevator, the elevator doorway and first-floor restroom approaches. Pages 9–10 show tiered theatre seating and aisle stairs; page 15 shows second-floor seating and the elevator. PDF metadata dates the file May 19, 2026; individual photo dates are unknown. Its 80/20/45-minute act/intermission example is not a current running-time promise. Confirm your performance, break route, seat and equipment arrangements: the narrative describes exits at the top of stairs and does not establish a continuous step-free route, measured clearances, adult-changing facilities or current elevator operation.

title: Emery social narrative: lobby, restrooms and calming room (October 2026)
description: Seven-page photo narrative for the October 2026 Mary Poppins JR. production. Pages 2–3 show the exterior and entrance facade; page 4 shows the lobby, Box Office, stairs and seating; page 5 includes restroom interiors, lobby seating and a view into the calming room; pages 6–7 show tiered auditorium seating and aisle stairs. The document describes automatic flushing, hand dryers/paper towels and possible metal-detector screening. Its performance instructions, arrival timing, food policy and running time belong to that show and need current confirmation. Photos are credited in the original; capture dates are unknown. Neither the images nor text establish measured clearances, a continuous step-free route, adult-changing equipment or current operation.
documentDate: October 9, 2026 (PDF metadata); October 2026 production; photo dates unknown

title: Inside the JCC locker rooms
description: Four-page photo narrative showing the lobby/security-gate approach, locker-room corridor and fob reader (page 1), lockers and Welcome Desk (page 2), towel shelves and shower interiors (page 3), and the pool doorway (page 4). Its described approach uses stairs; it does not show an elevator route, measured clearances, transfer equipment or adult changing tables. Individual photo dates are unknown. Confirm guest entry and current arrangements.

title: Preparing for a private swim lesson
description: Two-page photo narrative showing the building exterior, shower, poolside chairs, pool and locker-room interior. It describes the locker-room approach and possible pool noise, but does not demonstrate a step-free pool entry, a lift or transfer assistance. Photo dates are unknown; confirm the lesson location and equipment.

title: Arriving for Theatre at the J
description: Seven-page photo narrative. Pages 1–2 show the exterior, check-in, Welcome Desk/security gates and rows of movable auditorium chairs; later pages describe crowds, lighting, sound and taking breaks. Photos include performers and visitors and have unknown capture dates. This is not a measured route or guarantee of the current seating arrangement.

title: Artistic Entrance, elevator and studio photo narrative
description: Historical 18-page walkthrough linked by the Academy for CB Moves youth students: parking and Artistic Entrance doors on pages 2–5; hallway and elevator controls on pages 6–7; meditation/nursing room on page 9; Everybody Restroom approach and changing booths on pages 11–12; studio waiting seats and return elevator route on pages 13–18. PDF metadata dates it October 2021; photo dates are unknown. Its mask rule and other procedures are historical, not verified current policy. It does not establish current lift operation, assistance, dimensions or a continuous accessible route. Confirm your class entrance and arrangements with the Ballet.

title: Mason sensory guide and attraction photographs
description: The publisher’s 27-page Mason guide describes sensory conditions and includes attraction photographs on pages 13–20, Grand Lobby and mini-golf views on page 24, arcade views on page 25 and bowling on page 27. Photographs may be representative; capture dates are unknown. This is not a complete access-route walkthrough and does not establish pool-lift operation, transfer assistance, toilet layouts or current conditions.

title: Inside the zoo calming room
description: The 22-page narrative shows the gated approach on page 4, the room on pages 2 and 6, lighting and equipment controls on pages 8–12, seating and sensory items on pages 13–18, and the exit door on page 20. January 2020 file metadata; individual photo dates are unknown. This older room example does not establish the layout or equipment of both current calming rooms. Confirm staff entry and current arrangements with the zoo.

title: Roo Valley paths, gates and resting place
description: The 2025 narrative shows the descending approach on page 4, queue and entrance on pages 6–7, penguin doorway on page 11, stone seating on page 12, and exit gates and uphill return on pages 13–14. It describes opening only one entrance gate at a time. The photos do not establish gradients, widths, door effort or an uninterrupted step-free route; photo dates are unknown.

title: Giraffe feeding queue and handwashing
description: The 2025 photo narrative shows the railed queue and payment counter on pages 5–6, handwashing stations on pages 7 and 17, the feeding area and lower mesh on pages 11–14, and exit on page 16. The contents page is offset from the PDF page numbers used here. This is preparation material, not evidence of counter reach, tap operation, route dimensions or current waiting times; photo dates are unknown.

title: Paycor restrooms, club entrances and wayfinding — 2026 gallery
description: The Bengals’ July 21, 2026 article includes 26 photographs. Views 2–4 show general-restroom sinks, a stall approach and urinals; 6 shows club-entrance stairs and escalators; 10–11 show club restrooms; 12 shows lounge stairs; 16 shows part of a suite restroom; 22–23 show Pro Shop aisles; and 25–26 show signs and a seating-section passage. Club and suite views are not evidence of facilities available with every ticket. Individual photo dates, dimensions, adult-changing provision, elevator alternatives and current operation are not established. Photos remain on the publisher’s site; no reuse licence was found.
documentDate: Published July 21, 2026; individual photo dates unknown

title: Family Zone walkways, seats and nursing room — design gallery
description: The project architect’s seven photographs show the outdoor play area and its approach (views 1 and 4), indoor activity room (2), swinging benches and adjacent paved strip (3 and 6), lounge seating beside the play area (5), and nursing-room chairs and partitions (7). Some views contain visitors. The page describes a sensory room, but the gallery does not clearly identify a photograph of that room. Publication and photo dates are unknown; the image-file paths contain 2020/08, which is not a verified capture date. These design views do not establish current furniture, room access, dimensions, toilet provision or an uninterrupted route. Images remain with the architect; no reuse licence was found.

title: Riverbend and PNC Pavilion seat-view photographs
description: Below the illustrated venue map, the official page offers 19 Riverbend and 13 PNC Pavilion section-view photographs. Expand the relevant venue and choose a section. Riverbend’s 700–900 views show blue rails, rows of seats and roof/support structures; PNC’s 201, 203–205 views show portions of stepped aisles between seat rows. These largely empty-venue images do not establish a seated sightline during a standing crowd, identify an ADA bay, or show a continuous entrance-to-seat route. Photo dates are unknown. The map itself is an illustration, not photographic evidence. No reuse licence was found; the photographs remain on the venue’s site.

title: Door and adjoining sign on the mission’s About page
description: The About page includes one photograph of a red door, its handle and lock, part of the concrete approach, and a freestanding meal sign. The photograph’s capture date is unknown; its file path contains February 2025, which is not a verified photo date. The image does not identify whether this is the guest entrance used today or show the full parking route, door effort, threshold dimensions or toilets. The sign is historical visual context, not a same-day service notice. No reuse licence was found, so the photograph remains on the mission’s website.

title: Arena stairs, concourses and seating-edge railings
description: The supplier’s one-page case study contains seven photographs: a seating-bowl overview, upper seating stairs, suite-seat edges, concourse railings, the grand staircase, the Suite 08 approach and a platform edge the supplier labels an ADA section. These are views of the renovation completed in November 2018; the PDF has November 2023 metadata, and individual capture dates are unknown. It does not show a complete entrance-to-seat route, elevator operation, toilets or current ticket allocation. The supplier’s compliance wording is not an independent access audit. Photographs remain with their publisher; no reuse licence was found.
documentDate: November 2023 PDF metadata; renovation completed November 2018

title: Arena entrance plaza, wayfinding and concourse photographs
description: The architect’s project page contains nine photographs and a separate design sketch. The entry-hall photo shows an overhead sign pointing toward the ticket office, Champions Club and elevator; other views show the plaza, door rows, concourse and Armory Bar, seating bowl, and a team corridor. The final comparison includes the old pre-renovation frontage, a sketch and the completed frontage; the sketch is not a photograph. Individual capture dates are unknown, and the project completion year is 2018. A sign does not establish the elevator’s location, operation or a continuous route. Team and premium areas are not necessarily open to every visitor. No reuse licence was found; images remain with the architect.

title: Storefront steps and partial ramp
description: Brighton Center’s program page includes one storefront photograph showing the Thrifting on Eastern sign, number 2014 on the porch post, front steps and a railed ramp running along the facade toward the porch. The lower ramp approach is beyond the right edge. The doorway is in shadow; threshold, door controls, slope, width and a complete sidewalk-to-shop route cannot be verified. Capture date and current route operation are unknown. No reuse licence was found, so the photo remains on Brighton Center’s page.

title: Redden Gardens fridge, shelves and kiosk approach
description: Three relevant Redden Gardens photographs on the operator’s broader page show the fridge shelter and rough paved foreground, open pantry shelves with a microwave and water dispenser to the side, and the wellness kiosk beside the fridge. The kiosk sits on a raised concrete pad; a cardboard pile is visible beside it in that view. Photos do not establish a step-free approach, door force, shelf/control reach, available stock or current obstructions. Capture dates are unknown; the filename “fridge-2026” is not a verified photo date. The separately labeled Banklick photo shows another location. No reuse licence was found; these images remain on COVUnity’s site.

title: Concert hall, theatre seating and outdoor amphitheater views
description: Seven photographs on NKU’s facilities page include Greaves Concert Hall from the audience, Corbett Theatre from the stage, an outdoor amphitheater with concrete tiers and handrails, the building by the lake, and gallery, rehearsal and practice-room scenes. The Corbett view shows stepped seating aisles with small edge lights; it does not locate accessible seating. Several images contain performers or visitors, and teaching rooms are not public quiet spaces. Capture dates are unknown and images may predate later Fine Arts renovations. Current layouts, alternate routes, toilets and door controls are unverified. No reuse licence was found; the photographs remain on NKU’s page.

title: Fine Arts frontage, paving and benches
description: One university photograph shows the facade labeled Gallery / NKU Corbett Theatre, paved foreground, benches beside grass, and distant dark entrance doors. The sign identifies the building but does not identify the glass-door arrival point in SOTA’s current directions. Capture date, paving gradients, thresholds, door controls and a continuous route from parking are unverified. No reuse licence was found; the image stays on NKU’s building-information page.

title: Museum gallery passages, displays and lighting
description: Nine photographs on the 2019 renovation designer’s project page show carpeted passages between exhibit cases, a red floor line, display islands, wall screens, the broadcasting desk, baseball-card area and the Champions Gallery’s large video wall. Lighting varies across the photographed rooms, but still images cannot establish brightness levels, sound or flashing effects. Some views contain visitors. Individual capture dates are unknown; the photographs do not establish current layouts, door widths, counter reach, restrooms or the elevator route. No reuse licence was found, so the images remain with the designer.
documentDate: 2019 renovation project; individual photo dates unknown

title: Exhibit passages, seating and wraparound screens
description: The museum’s Exhibits page has 70 inspected photographs and a separate Big Red Machine graphic. Useful views include a short row of red seats facing an exhibit screen, red upholstered benches and angled touchscreens in the Hall of Fame Gallery, carpeted passages between display cases, pull-out baseball-card panels and the Champions Gallery video wall. Many other images are close-ups of artifacts, not access routes. Several photos also appear on the 2019 designer page; a currently available webpage does not establish when a photo was taken. Capture dates, present layout, screen motion/flashing, sound levels, seat dimensions, toilets and elevator access remain unverified. Images stay on the Reds’ page; no reuse licence was found.
publisher: Cincinnati Reds Hall of Fame and Museum
documentDate: Current exhibit webpage; individual capture dates unknown

title: Entrance, lifts, restrooms and quiet-area photo narrative
description: Seventeen-page official narrative: exterior and parking views on pages 2–5; box office and lobby seating on 6–7; first-floor restroom corridor and elevator on 8; third-floor stairs, lift and restroom on 9; second-floor toilet doors on 10; theatre entries and tiered seating on 11–13; mezzanine quiet-area directions on 15; inside face of the street doors on 17. Includes a map and an illustrative audience photo. PDF metadata is dated April 6, 2026, hosted in a May 2026 folder; individual photo dates are unknown. The narrative calls the theatre 180 seats while the current FAQ says 182. Images do not establish measurements, current lift operation or a continuous route; the mezzanine is not guaranteed silent. No reuse licence found; images stay in the original guide.
documentDate: April 6, 2026 PDF metadata; May 2026 upload path

title: Front stairs, theatre aisles and interior photo tour
description: The official photo tour contains 20 distinct photographs, repeated in its gallery markup. They show front-door stairs and handrails, tiered theatre seating and aisles, seat armrests, lobby/corridor doorways, interior stairs and event-room layouts. Several views are decorative details and two show an attended event; these are not quiet-room or everyday furniture guarantees. The inspected photos do not show the north-side street-level elevator entrance or identify toilet interiors. Capture dates are unknown; no dimensions, complete route, current elevator operation or reserved wheelchair-seat location is established. No reuse licence found; photographs remain on the venue’s site.

title: Banklick fridge shelter and paved foreground
description: The operator’s separately labeled Banklick Street photograph shows a closed fridge/freezer in a wooden shelter at night, the raised lower wooden edge, paving slabs and an adjacent trash bin. It does not show the fridge interior, shelf reach, door force or a complete approach from the sidewalk. Capture date, present stock, lighting and equipment operation are unknown. Other photographs on the page depict Redden Gardens and must not be treated as Banklick facilities. No reuse licence found; the photo stays on the operator’s page.

title: GRIT chair models, booking and collection guide
description: Four-page official equipment guide with product photographs of the Spartan and Junior models on pages 1–2, reservation and Friday collection instructions on page 3, and contact details on page 4. PDF metadata is dated October 2, 2026; the document does not state a revision date. This is an equipment guide, not a photographic route audit. Supplied supports, individual fit, current availability, transfer help and collection arrangements need confirmation; illustrations do not override the written equipment limits. No reuse licence found; images remain in the original PDF.
documentDate: October 2, 2026 PDF metadata; revision date unstated

title: Lake launch ramp, rails and floating platform
description: The lake page includes one inspected photograph looking from the concrete approach down a metal ramp with handrails to the floating kayak-launch platform and transfer hardware. The joints at the ramp ends are visible; width, slope, water level, transfer operation and the complete route from parking are not measured or established. Capture date is unknown. The page currently says kayak/paddleboard rentals are closed for the season, with reopening information due in spring 2027; the photograph does not establish present launch conditions. No reuse licence found; the image stays on the operator’s page.

title: Entrance forecourt, pool decks and slide stairs
description: Four inspected city photographs include an empty entrance forecourt with gates and temporary queue chains, an empty pool deck beside the lazy river and stair access to slides, a busy overhead pool view, and a swim lesson. The first two provide useful facility context without a crowd; the latter views do not promise attendance levels, lesson support or assistance. Capture dates are unknown; upload paths range from February 2021 to July 2026. No toilet interior, adult changing equipment, measured route or current transfer-device operation is established. The calendar on the page describes the completed 2026 season; Phase 1 renovation impacts and 2027 arrangements remain unverified. No reuse licence found; photographs remain on the city page.

title: Park paths, canopy seating and activity photos
description: The city gallery includes a close view of patterned paving, planters and a row of seats, a canopy plaza view and a restaurant patio with railings. Other images show playgrounds, skating, crowds and fireworks. Nine gallery images inspected; capture dates are not established by upload filenames. This is orientation material, not a toilet, elevator or continuous arrival-route walkthrough; tower and water-corridor closure notices still apply.

title: Architect gallery: paved approaches, seating and steps
description: Eighteen photographs show canopy paving and tables, playground surfaces, tower approaches and a pergola with prominent steps and railings. Three additional views are drawings or a model, not documentary photos. The gallery includes earlier restaurant branding; exact photo dates are unknown, and the current October 2026 tower closure still applies. No toilet interiors, elevator controls, dimensions or complete step-free routes are established.

title: Nearby Ziegler garage: stairs and pedestrian pavilions
description: Six architect photographs show the nearby garage entrance, broad exterior steps, a glazed stair pavilion, upper paved paths and the lawn above the garage. The project page identifies August 2017 completion; photo dates are unknown. These are garage orientation views, not theater entry photos. They do not show elevator controls, establish current lift operation or verify a continuous route from the garage to Woodward.
documentDate: Project completed August 2017; photo dates unknown

title: Tournament campus: court steps, paths and seating
description: Eight inspected campus views show court seating and stair aisles, broad paved circulation areas, outdoor tables with shade structures and a bar interior. These are project views rather than an access walkthrough; some spaces have separate ticket or player access rules. Capture dates are not stated. Photos do not locate an accessible toilet, prove a continuous entrance-to-seat route or establish current elevator and shuttle operation.

title: First Aid and Nursing Station sign in the official map
description: The map’s Mercy Health First Aid Center entry uses a photograph of the First Aid and Nursing Station sign above glass doors. Only the upper doorway is visible; the threshold, interior and nursing facilities are not shown. Photo capture date is unconfirmed. The parking, misting and water-station entries inspected use general crowd or entrance pictures rather than documentary views of those features. Use the map labels and current tournament instructions for orientation.

title: State-page photograph: narrow winter woodland path
description: The state page’s Boone Cliffs header photograph shows a narrow snow-covered woodland path with leaves and trees beside a wooded slope. The photo’s filename identifies Boone County Cliffs, but the exact trail segment and capture date are unknown. It does not show the car park, trailhead connection, toilets, gradients or current surface condition. The page also describes Dinsmore Woods separately; do not transfer that unit’s directions to Boone Cliffs. No reuse licence established; the photograph remains on the state page.

title: Reopening photos: wooden approach, handrails and entrance
description: Three photographs on the city’s September 25, 2026 reopening page show the wooden approach with railings and handrails, a closer view toward the treehouse with a transverse surface strip, and the surrounding deck. One view includes a Now Open banner. The article describes structural timber, guardrail and roof work; exact photo capture dates are unstated. These views do not establish slope, clear width, the parking-to-walkway connection, toilets or present surface condition. Images remain on the original city page; no reuse licence established.
documentDate: Article published September 25, 2026; photo dates unstated

title: Historical photographer tour: lobby ramp and exhibit lighting
description: The entry panorama shows an interior sloping walkway with railings beside a lobby counter, nearby upholstered seating and brightly lit sign displays. Four directions of this panorama were inspected. The photographer’s tour files are labeled 2020; capture dates are unconfirmed and the tour predates the July 2024 expansion. It does not verify current routes, ramp dimensions, door controls, toilets or the stair-only library. Copyright remains with the photographer; images are linked on the original tour, not republished.
documentDate: Tour files labeled 2020; capture dates unconfirmed

title: Official event-room and library photographs
description: Twelve inspected views show gallery audience rows and banquet tables, bright sign displays, theatre table seating and the library’s shared table, loose chairs and rug. Event arrangements vary, and several views include guests. Capture dates are unconfirmed; some library filenames refer to August 2023. The photos do not show the library stair approach or a step-free alternative, toilets, transfer space or the route from parking. The linked library FAQ separately reports one flight of stairs and no elevator. Images remain on the museum’s page; no reuse licence established.

title: Official front-door stair photograph
description: The About page’s exterior photograph shows steps with a central handrail leading to the front double doors, beside hedges. Capture date is unknown. This is a visible stair approach, not the elevator route described in the November 2026 program. The parking-to-elevator connection, thresholds, toilet interior and current condition are not shown. The image remains on the theater’s page; no reuse licence established.

title: Official pool, welcome-desk and fitness-floor photographs
description: Four inspected branch images include two views of the indoor pool and tiled deck with entry handrails, a curved welcome desk with different counter heights, and rows of fitness equipment. The fitness-floor photo includes visitors. Capture dates are unknown. These partial views do not establish a continuous entrance route, counter dimensions, pool-lift operation, transfer assistance or changing/toilet facilities, and do not resolve the conflicting pool-operation text. Images remain on the YMCA page; no reuse licence established.

title: Historical Taft visual narrative: entrance, lobby and restroom doors
description: This 2023 performance narrative includes photographs of the marquee entrance, security screening, busy lobby, restroom doors and signs, auditorium and fixed seating. Pages 2–7 were visually inspected. Photo capture dates are unstated and several views include visitors. Its food, quiet-space, sensory-bag and admission arrangements are specific to that historical performance, not current venue policy. Restroom interiors, transfer space, door controls and a continuous step-free route are not established. Linked at the original publisher; no reuse licence established.
documentDate: PDF metadata created/modified October 17, 2023; photo dates unstated

title: Historical arena photo narrative: elevators, entrance and restroom
description: This 26-page Cyclones narrative includes garage elevators beside a stair approach (page 3), the plaza entrance and ticket windows (4), screening (5), outer concourse (7), restroom stalls and a single toilet with sink and grab bars (8), and arena seating and inner concourse (12 and 14). These pages were visually inspected. PDF metadata dates the document to October 2019; individual capture dates are unknown and some photos contain visitors. It does not establish current routes, door controls, toilet transfer space or adult changing equipment. Its Chill Zone and sensory-game arrangements are historical, not current policy. Linked at the venue’s original PDF; no reuse licence established.
documentDate: PDF created October 30, 2019; photo dates unstated

title: Official photographs: gazebo steps and pavilion stage
description: Two inspected gallery views show the Hinkle Gazebo stair approach and Seasongood Pavilion’s raised stage, side stairs and paved foreground. Capture dates are unstated. The stage view does not show the seating-area ramps described in a separate 2020 article, a continuous route from parking, gradients or toilet interiors. Other gallery views are landscape context. Images remain on the city page; no reuse licence established.

title: Official photographs: gym and ceramics rooms
description: Four inspected branch photographs show a gym floor and net, two ceramics-room views with tables, stools and equipment, and part of the exterior. The exterior is cut off near the lower doorway, so the approach and threshold are not visible. Capture dates are unknown. These partial views do not establish aisle widths, a continuous entrance route, toilet/changing arrangements or pool entry. Images remain on the city page; no reuse licence established.

title: Historical Opera photo guide: screening, sinks, seating and break room
description: The 18-page guide is for the June 21, 2025 Tosca rehearsal, although the Opera’s July 2026 sensory-event page still links it. Photographs on pages 4, 5, 7, 8, 11, 13 and 15 show screening poles, the box-office counter, a row of restroom sinks, Guest Services, fixed armrest seats, auditorium rows and a furnished break room beside a lobby view. All pages were visually reviewed; photo capture dates are unstated. The toilet stalls and transfer space are not shown. Its food, lighting, screening and break-room arrangements belong to that historical rehearsal and do not establish current concert policy or room availability. Linked at the original publisher; no reuse licence established.
documentDate: June 21, 2025 rehearsal; PDF created April 11, 2025; photo dates unstated

title: Official guide: four vendor approaches and ramps
description: Four inspected photographs in the October 14, 2026 article show Oddfellows Attire/Fiona’s Fineries, The White Seahorse, Folkvardrs Horns and The Knotted Cloak. Visible details include gravel-to-wood transitions, raised decks, railings and a ramp running beside the Knotted Cloak building. The views do not measure slopes, thresholds or door widths, show every shop, or confirm 2027 conditions. Capture dates are unstated. The surrounding maps, aerial imagery and ticket screenshot are not ground-level photographs. Original images remain with the publisher; no reuse licence established.
documentDate: Article October 14, 2026; photo capture dates unstated

title: Historical newsletter: Flatboat ramp and drainage work
description: Page 1 of this eight-page Summer 2019 newsletter shows a narrow ramp/path beside the Flatboat and a separate roadside-gutter construction photograph. The article describes Flatboat/Vorhes access work as being completed; it is not confirmation of today’s routes or completion at both buildings. Photo capture dates are unstated. Ramp width, gradient, thresholds, toilet access and current condition cannot be established. Linked to the original museum PDF; photographs are not republished and no reuse licence is established.
documentDate: Summer 2019 issue; PDF created December 20, 2019; photo dates unstated

title: Museum building photographs: steps, porches and approaches
description: Fifteen building photographs were inspected, including a repeated Hayner House view. They show front steps at Hayner, Vorhes, Somerset Church and Myers Schoolhouse; a railed approach at Schram Print Shop; and porch or doorway views at other buildings. The original gallery’s photographs are small and their capture dates are unstated; some filenames refer to fall 2015. They do not show a continuous entrance route, current alternatives, door controls or toilets. The stock-style audio-tour illustration is not counted as a venue photograph. Images remain on the museum’s page; no reuse licence established.
documentDate: Capture dates unstated; some filenames reference fall 2015

title: Property-owner photograph: storefront and curb approach
description: The first property-gallery photograph shows the Whole Foods storefront, glass doorways, shopping carts and merchandise beside the doors, and a break in the yellow curb at the paved approach. Capture date is unstated. It does not establish a continuous route from accessible parking, door operation, threshold height, clear width, current obstructions or pickup arrangements. Other photographs show different Rookwood businesses. Linked to the property owner’s original gallery; no reuse licence established.

title: Official branch photograph: sheltered entrance and railing
description: The branch-page photograph shows the sheltered entrance at the left, pavement and curb across the foreground, and a long concrete wall with a metal railing beside the building. The railing partly hides the adjoining path; this view does not establish a continuous step-free route, slope, threshold height, door controls or parking-bay connection. Capture date is unstated; July 2023 in the image path is not a verified capture date. Image remains on the library page; no reuse licence established.

title: Official panoramic photographs: plaza, floor and balcony seating
description: Six photographic panoramas show the outside plaza, steps and railings; the empty auditorium floor and raised stage; fixed-seat rows and stepped aisles in Balcony 1 and Balcony 2; and side walkways and stairs in the Headliner and Spotlight sections. Ladders and work equipment are visible in the empty venue. Capture dates are unstated. Panorama distortion prevents measurements, and these views do not identify designated wheelchair/companion positions, toilet access, a continuous step-free garage route or working elevators. Original images remain on the venue’s tour page; no reuse licence established.
publisher: The Andrew J Brady Music Center

title: 2024 opening photographs: entrance, courtyard and study rooms
description: Seven ground-level photographs in the August 29, 2024 opening article show the paved entrance approach, front doorway from two angles, colored outdoor posts, courtyard benches and fixed-bench picnic tables, and glass study-room doors beside shelving. A repeated entrance image, aerial view, promotional rendering and graphics are excluded from this count. Capture dates are unstated and the article precedes opening; the views do not confirm current obstructions, dimensions, door operation, drive-thru procedures or room availability. The described adult changing facility is not pictured in these views. Images remain with the library; no reuse licence established.
documentDate: Article August 29, 2024, before the September 2024 opening; photo dates unstated

title: Architect’s photographs: parking edge, rooms and stepped platform
description: Twenty-seven inspected project photographs show marked parking and a curb transition, the entrance frontage, information desk, shelf aisles, several seating types, glass study-room doors, meeting rooms and the paved patio. One indoor activity-room view shows a raised platform with steps and handrails; no alternative route onto that platform is established. Photographs are undated and project prose includes future-tense design intentions, so neither confirms current operations, bus service, room layout, toilet facilities or a continuous measured route. Images remain on the architect’s site; no reuse licence established.
documentDate: Undated project gallery; capture dates unstated

title: Official branch photograph: front doors and nearby parking signs
description: The branch page’s wide photograph shows the front-door area, adjoining paving and parking signs across a lawn. The entrance is distant, so thresholds, controls, gradient, the curbside collection space and a complete parking-to-door connection cannot be checked from this view. Capture date is unstated; the image file is in a June 2023 upload path. Images remain with the library; no reuse licence established.
documentDate: Capture date unknown; image upload path June 2023

title: Project photographs: front approach, service desk and outdoor seating
description: Three useful ground-level project photographs show the paved entrance approach with bollards, an interior service desk beside shelving and circulation space, and chairs on paving outside the glass wall. A fourth roof view is excluded from this count. Some images include visitors. The project page names 2024 and credits Frank Doring Photography; capture dates are not stated. These views do not show the adult changing table, hearing-loop equipment, drive-thru handoff or a measured continuous route. Original images remain with the project team; no reuse licence established.
publisher: Brown + Kubican; photographs credited to Frank Doring
documentDate: Project year 2024; photograph capture dates unstated

title: Official gallery: entry area, seating, patio and lighting
description: Eleven inspected venue photographs show the host-stand/entry area, booths and freestanding tables, bar stools, colorful interior lighting, patio tables and a fireplace. A winter exterior view shows snow beside the doorway; the image labeled entrance by the publisher is an interior seating/entry view. A catering-poster photograph is excluded. Capture dates are unknown. The gallery does not establish doorway or table dimensions, operating door controls, present furniture layout, toilet access or a clear route during snow. Images remain at the restaurant’s site; no reuse licence established.
documentDate: Undated official venue gallery; includes a winter exterior

title: Official lounge photograph: low table, chairs and rugs
description: The reservation page’s photograph shows a low oval table closely surrounded by upholstered chairs and a sofa, with rugs over a wood floor and a piano behind the seating. It is useful for asking about furniture movement and rug edges; it does not establish wheelchair clearance, a route through the lounge, entrance steps or toilet access. The file name mentions 2025, but the capture date is not independently established. Image remains with the venue; no reuse licence established.
documentDate: Capture date unstated; image filename refers to 2025

title: Official interior photograph: long table and bar stools
description: The homepage’s main interior photograph shows a long table with chairs, candleholders and menus in front of a bar with high stools. It shows one seating arrangement in a dim interior, not measured light levels or a guaranteed current layout. Entrance, toilets, table knee clearance and routes around the furniture are not established. Image remains with the venue; no reuse licence established.

title: June 2021 photographs: raised doorway, indoor seating and patio
description: Four inspected photographs show a raised corner doorway with railings, chairs and high stools beside the service counter, window-counter seating along an interior passage, and tables under a timber patio cover. They accompany a tourism writer’s visit published June 25, 2021; exact capture dates are unconfirmed. Some interior views include diners. These historical views do not establish current furniture, doorway dimensions, an alternative entrance, a continuous step-free route, toilet access or winter patio operation. Photographs remain with the original publisher; no reuse licence established.
publisher: Visit Cincy / meetNKY; article by Rebecca Banks
documentDate: Article June 25, 2021; exact photo capture dates unconfirmed

title: Official coworking-room photograph: tables, stools and doors
description: The page’s wide, unoccupied room photograph shows small tables with chairs, a banquette, a higher central counter with stools, a drinks counter and doors. It helps compare seating types and ask about furniture clearance. Capture date and dimensions are unstated; the photograph does not establish a step-free entrance, toilet access, sound levels or today’s layout. Coworking access is paid and conditional on the event suite not being rented. The original photograph remains with the venue; no reuse licence established.

title: Library impact report: Walton restroom, changing table and approach
description: PDF page 7 of this nine-page report shows Walton’s front approach and a small labeled photograph of the inclusive restroom with a padded adult changing table, two toilets and grab rails, alongside courtyard seating, EV charging and Innovation Lab views. All nine PDF pages were inspected; many are two-page spreads. The report covers fiscal year 2024–25 and its PDF metadata dates from January 29, 2026; photograph capture dates are unstated. The restroom image does not establish table dimensions or load limit, adjustment controls, hoist provision, transfer assistance, door controls or today’s condition. Original report linked; no image reuse licence established.

title: Entrance and paved patio photograph
description: The official taproom page includes a color exterior photograph of the glass entrance door, visible threshold, pavers, patio tables, chairs and stools. The image shows only part of the approach: it does not establish a continuous route from parking, doorway width, door-opening force or restroom access. The photograph date and current furniture arrangement are unknown.

title: Taproom indoor virtual tour
description: The brewery’s official tour page embeds Google panoramas credited to Joseph Danzer. Two inspected indoor views show the bar with tall chairs, communal picnic-style bench tables, food counter and an adjoining corridor. These views help compare seating types; they do not document every route, measure clearances or establish restroom fittings or rooftop access. Capture dates are unconfirmed. An outdoor panorama also exists but was not assessed because its preview did not resolve clearly.
publisher: Little Miami Brewing Company · Google panoramas by Joseph Danzer

title: Parking and suggested wheelchair routes
description: Three inspected venue drawings show the exterior parking and entrances, the suggested first-floor route into Shawnee Theater, and the third-floor route from the elevator into Myaamia Hall. These are maps, not documentary photographs or measured clearance surveys. Read alongside the explicit second-floor balcony restriction and first-floor restroom gap. Event seating and current arrangements need confirmation.

title: Entrance stairs, alternative doorway and event rooms
description: Six inspected photographs in the official gallery show the historic front stairway, a separate modern glass entrance beside parking, and empty event-room floors with raised stages or perimeter platforms. Compare the entrance views with the access page’s west/north doorway instructions. These undated photographs do not establish door measurements, routes onto stages, current seating or lift operation.

title: Barn approaches and paved path photographs
description: Two selected views on the official preserve page show a paved path between timber rails toward Ellenwood Nature Barn and a separate paved strip beside the red barn. One filename references April 20, 2021, but capture dates are not independently established. Door thresholds, gradients, parking connections and toilets are outside these views. They do not resolve the conflicting trail-surface descriptions.

title: Pin Oak wooded path photograph
description: The trail page’s banner shows visitors on a paved wooded path with leaves on the surface. The capture date and complete route are unknown; the view does not settle the 2026 trail log’s natural-surface description, total distance, gradient or current condition. Other gallery pictures mainly show wildlife and vegetation.

title: Cotswold paved approach and bench
description: The official visitor-center photograph shows a paved approach and a bench beside planting beds, with portions of the building entrance obscured by vegetation. Capture date is unknown. It does not show door controls, thresholds, toilet interiors or the temporary portable toilet named in the maintenance notice.

title: Highfield boardwalk and paving transition
description: One selected image in the official garden gallery shows a timber path meeting paving near the garden building, bordered by raised planting beds. Capture date is unknown, and the photograph may predate the documented 2025 improvements. It does not establish the current entrance, widths, gradients or restroom access; other gallery images include raised play structures and children.

title: Visitor-center entrance and exhibit interior
description: Two selected official photographs show the concrete approach to paired glass doors and a windowed exhibit space with a floor-level route around a central display. Capture dates are unknown. Door width, opening controls, complete routes, toilets and current lighting are not established. The gallery also contains visitor and wildlife photographs that are not access evidence.

title: Historical trail, entrance and room photographs
description: Pages 11–13 of this 23-page presentation (PDF metadata dated April 2024) show the visitor-center exterior, a raised bird-viewing blind reached by stairs, an interpretive sign, indoor exhibit routes, meeting-room chairs and tables, and glass lobby doors. The presentation also covers other sites. Photograph dates are not supplied. The blind view does not show an alternative route; the photographs do not establish current layouts, measured clearances, toilet fittings or personal assistance.
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Legacy Management

title: Preserve and barn orientation map
description: The operator’s embedded map locates paths and visitor facilities around the barn. This is an orientation drawing, not a photograph or measured access survey. Its version date, route gradients, surface condition and complete step-free connections are unknown. Check current closures separately.

title: Park and visitor-center orientation map
description: The operator’s embedded map locates paths and visitor facilities around the park and visitor center. This is an orientation drawing, not a photograph or measured access survey. Its version date, route gradients, surface condition and complete step-free connections are unknown. Check current closures separately.

title: Historical meeting-room layout photograph
description: The official gallery, last updated April 14, 2020, includes a clear room photograph with rows of movable tables, wheeled chairs with arms, chairs along the wall, closed double doors and ceiling lighting. The photograph’s capture date is unknown. It illustrates a historical classroom-style arrangement, not current capacity, measured table clearance, reserved wheelchair positions or lighting conditions. Other gallery views show group activities.

title: Campus route map around Truist Arena
description: NKU’s one-page map identifies Truist Arena as building 21, the nearby Arena Garage and Lot O. Its legend distinguishes ground-level and plaza-level routes, powered-door entrance symbols, disability parking and bus stops; it also marks construction elsewhere on campus. The map prints “Revised Jun 2025”; this currently linked file is dated September 2025 in its filename. This is a route drawing, not a photograph, and does not establish current door operation, event-specific entry, elevator availability or permission to use every parking area.

title: Chestnut Street Station waiting areas and restroom approach
description: The agency’s station gallery shows covered bus bays, curb edges and red patterned curbside strips, benches outside and along the indoor hall, restroom-direction signs and the recessed restroom approach, and a meeting room with movable tables and chairs. Eleven photographs were inspected, including maintenance-area views that are not public boarding routes. Capture dates are unknown; the March 2026 asset paths are not photo dates. No restroom interior, adult changing equipment, measured doorway clearance, current boarding equipment or continuous parking route is established. A night exterior includes snow.

title: LeBlond playground ramp, path and indoor court
description: CRC’s four-photo slideshow includes a playground ramp with handrails, adjoining play-surface transitions, a curving paved outdoor path beside a wall, an indoor court with doors and folded equipment, and a cropped building facade. Capture dates are unknown. The facade omits the ground-level approach; the other views do not establish measured grades, the full parking-to-playground route, equipment transfer access, door operation, toilets or current conditions.

title: Historical taproom tables, chairs and lighting
description: This photograph accompanies Visit Cincy / meetNKY’s May 24, 2023 preview. It shows closely arranged wood tables, separate chairs with backs, higher bar seating, a window-side counter, ceiling decorations and several light sources. Exact capture date is unknown. It does not establish table heights, wheelchair clearances, current layout, noise or a quiet area. The original tourism article remains linked; no image is republished by Threshold.

title: Historical restroom sink and doorway view
description: This photograph accompanies Visit Cincy / meetNKY’s May 24, 2023 preview. It shows two wall-mounted sinks with visible pipes below, a mirror, towel dispenser, waste bin and a closed wooden door with a pull handle. Exact capture date is unknown. The toilet, doorway opening, turning space and changing facilities are outside the view; sink clearance, reach, door force and present conditions cannot be determined.

title: Dayton storefront entrances, shop floor and creator-space seating
description: Three store photographs show the recessed entrances, a sign directing visitors from the left door to the other entrance, the sidewalk edge and freestanding sign, book displays on a black-and-white patterned floor, and tables, stools, chairs and upholstered seating in the creator space. Capture dates are unknown. The doorway interiors and full threshold are not clearly shown; the images do not establish a step-free entrance, aisle or table clearances, stage access, toilet facilities or current layout. The crawl organizer separately reports an entrance step.

title: Pike Street entrance in an October 2025 report
description: The lead photograph shows the glass door marked 112, pull handle, entry mat, wall-mounted intercom, adjacent storefront and sidewalk with a bench and planter. The lower doorway is partly outside the frame: threshold height, door force and a continuous parking route cannot be assessed. Published before the shop opened in October 2025; capture date and current arrangement are unconfirmed. Photo credited to Maggy McDonel / LINK nky; linked at the publisher, not republished.
documentDate: October 23, 2025 publication; photo capture date unstated

title: Front steps and doorway on the shop website
description: The shop’s exterior photograph shows steps at the front door beneath a blue awning, with a bench and display vehicle outside. No ramp is visible in this view. It does not cover the side entrance shown in a separate 2023 news report, or establish door controls, a continuous route or current conditions. Capture date is unstated.

title: Historical side-ramp photograph (2023)
description: The article’s lead photo shows a wooden ramp with rails running along the building toward a side doorway; front steps remain visible. Published January 21, 2023, with credit to Katie Forcade / Spectrum News 1. It does not establish current operation, ramp measurements, door controls, access to every room or toilets. Capture date is unstated; this is a historical view, not current route verification.
documentDate: January 21, 2023 publication; photo capture date unstated

title: Depot frontage and indoor display vehicle
description: Two inspected homepage photographs show the storefront’s glass door and open garage doorway beside the paved apron, and the indoor display vehicle with a bench behind it. These are views of the fixed Sharonville shop, not a passenger transport service. They do not establish a continuous parking-to-door route, threshold measurements, entry into the display vehicle or toilet access. Capture dates are unstated.

title: Shelves, display table and interior doorway
description: The About page’s interior photograph shows bookshelves, a central display table, a rug edge, ceiling lighting and an open doorway. The furniture and display layout is visible, but clearances, route continuity and lighting or sound levels are not measured. No toilet or changing facilities are shown. Capture date is unstated; an upload path does not establish when the photo was taken.

title: Tax-office counter and exterior drop box
description: Two city photographs show the tax-office counter, including a lower section, and a blue-and-white tax drop box beside a glass entrance with a wheelchair symbol. The exterior view includes part of the concrete approach, pillars and a planter. These small images do not establish counter or box height, knee space, door controls, complete parking-to-door continuity or toilets. Capture dates are unstated; the page currently says the tax office has moved to City Hall.

title: Operator vehicle photos with service distinctions
description: Three homepage photographs show vehicles presented under Dial-A-Ride, Non-Emergency Medical Transportation and Route Express. Only the medical-transport photograph shows a raised side lift with a wheelchair passenger and staff member; that view does not establish equipment assigned to a Dial-A-Ride trip. The other vehicles have closed doors. Photo dates, lift dimensions, capacity, boarding surfaces and current fleet assignments are unknown.

title: Historical Dial-A-Ride brochure (January 2023)
description: Both PDF pages were reviewed. Page 1 includes a vehicle photo and a small photo of a passenger beside a front-entry grab rail; these do not show a deployed lift or establish transfer procedures. The brochure is marked Revised 1-2023. Its cancellation and child-fare wording differs from current webpages, so use it as historical orientation and confirm present arrangements with dispatch. Photo capture dates are unknown.
documentDate: Revised January 2023; photo capture dates unstated

title: Rookwood shop-floor displays and stairway
description: The official Rookwood location card shows a photograph looking across the lower shop floor: display tables and shelves, a central counter, overhead lighting and the stairs to the upper level. It complements the dated upper-level panorama but has no stated capture date. Furniture can change; aisle clearance, elevator location, entrances, toilets and a continuous route are not established. Linked at the shop; no reuse licence was identified.

title: Public-restroom update and earlier doors, seating and farm-shed views
description: The official project page shows a completed-project public-restroom photograph with sinks and cubicle doors. Its separate Before Photos gallery shows indoor and outdoor chairs/tables, market-house doors, two farm-shed views, a vendor restroom with grab bars and a folded baby-changing unit, and public-restroom construction. Eight selected views were inspected. The vendor room is not evidence of public access or adult changing; before photos do not establish finished work. Capture dates are unstated, and door controls, cubicle dimensions and continuous routes remain unverified. Original images stay with the publisher; no reuse licence was identified.
publisher: Findlay Forward / Corporation for Findlay Market

title: Library renovation gallery: parking, rooms, seating and signage
description: The library’s project page includes 11 reopening-era photographs with March 29, 2021 filenames, plus an exterior overview. They show the parking-facing addition, study/computer tables, shelves, meeting-room seating, armchairs and bilingual signs awaiting installation. These are historical preparation views, not a current layout audit; filenames are not independently confirmed capture dates. The page records the branch reopening in April 2021 and parklet completion in October 2023. Its separate parklet renderings and construction gallery are not completed access photographs. Toilets, elevator controls, thresholds and a continuous entrance route are not established. Twelve selected views were inspected; images are linked, not republished. The same page embeds a 5-minute-48-second ribbon-cutting video published April 12, 2021. A review of 23 sampled frames adds historical views of glazed entrance doors and immediately adjacent paving, meeting tables and computer desks; the audio and complete motion sequence were not reviewed. It does not establish a continuous route or today’s doors.

title: Official workshop-table photograph
description: The shop homepage’s workshop section shows participants seated close together at a shared craft table, with materials on the tabletop, shelves and large windows behind them. This can help with workshop preparation but gives no sound levels, clearances, entrance route, toilet details or assurance that the same layout will be used. Capture date is unknown. The homepage’s outdoor craft-market picture is a different setting. One workshop view was inspected and remains linked at the publisher; no reuse licence was identified.

title: Seasonal displays and surrounding floor space
description: Five photographs were inspected. The Halloween arrangement shows upholstered chairs, floor mats, low display objects and overhead lighting; the Coca-Cola display includes a low wagon with a long handle beside a table. These are merchandise displays, not identified visitor seating. Other close-ups add little route detail. The original gallery warns that stock changes. Capture dates are unknown (file paths include 2013); the images cannot establish current booth clearance, a continuous route, equipment availability or toilets. Linked at the publisher; no reuse licence established.
documentDate: Undated gallery; 2013 upload paths do not establish photo dates

title: Order windows, seating and outdoor surfaces
description: Eight Wooster Pike photographs were inspected on the official locations page. They show order-window frontage, picnic benches on sand and artificial turf, a raised concrete edge beside the sand, courts, a raised van-shaped seating area and indoor booths/tables. The van seating is not a verified accessible option. The page also covers other branches; use its Wooster Pike section. Capture dates, threshold heights, continuous routes, table clearance, toilets and current seasonal layouts remain unknown. Some views contain visitors; images remain with the operator because no reuse licence was found.

title: Pool deck, exercise floor and studio
description: Three official branch photographs show the indoor pool and deck with rails/ladders, rows of exercise equipment, and an empty mirrored studio. They help orient visitors to surfaces and room layouts, but do not establish clearances, pool-entry lift provision or operation, transfer help, changing/toilet facilities or the route from the entrance. Capture dates and current layouts are unknown. Images are linked at the YMCA; no reuse licence was found.

title: Pool deck, gym and studio
description: Three official branch photographs show the pool deck and rails, an arm-shaped apparatus beside the pool, the gym with an elevated railed track, and a studio with hanging exercise straps. The apparatus is not identified or shown operating; no pool lift availability or transfer support is verified. The track photograph does not show an elevator route. Capture dates, current equipment, doorways, clearances, toilets and changing arrangements remain unknown. One pool view includes swimmers. Images stay on the YMCA website; no reuse licence was found.

title: Drop-off floor plan: entrance, elevator and check-in
description: One-page diagram visually inspected in full. It marks the entrance, elevator, welcome area, customer check-in and labeled collection areas. This is a map, not a photograph or measured access audit. Unlabelled fixture symbols do not establish public toilet access, dimensions or changing facilities. The filename contains December 2, 2025; no current revision date or continuous usable route is confirmed. The PDF has no extractable text, so its labels may not be available to screen readers; ask the Hub for text directions. No reuse licence was found.
documentDate: December 2, 2025 in filename; current revision date unconfirmed

title: Seasonal rink supports and restroom-direction sign
description: Two photographs identified by the official page as Wooster Pike were inspected: skaters with freestanding plastic skating supports, and keg curling beside the rink barrier with a restroom-direction sign in the background. The supports are not verified adaptive equipment, and the sign does not establish a usable toilet route. Capture dates, present layout, rink entrance/transfer arrangements, support availability and toilet facilities remain unknown. The page separately describes Deerfield’s current curling league; a Wooster photograph does not establish a current Wooster league. Images include visitors and remain on the original site; no reuse licence was found.

title: Historical Hub arrival and collection-area photographs
description: All 15 pages of this December 2023 Hub presentation hosted by Ohio EPA were visually reviewed. Pages 1 and 14 show the building face marked 911 EVANS and parking foreground; page 14 also maps the Woodrow Street parking entrance and right-side Hub doors. Page 6 shows people and collection containers inside. Photographs are historical and partly circular-cropped by the original publisher; no individual capture dates or reuse licence were found. The presentation’s free-shopping arrangements are historical and differ from today’s Hub Club/Hub Shop information. It does not establish current thresholds, designated spaces, elevator operation, toilets, changing facilities or unloading help. Consult the Hub’s current drop-off instructions before travelling.
publisher: Cincinnati Recycling & Reuse Hub · hosted by Ohio EPA
documentDate: December 2023 presentation; PDF created December 7, 2023; individual photo dates unknown

title: Indoor waterpark, bubble-pool deck and exercise floor
description: Three branch photographs were inspected: the indoor waterpark with pool-edge rails and a slide stair tower, lap lanes beneath the bubble cover with deck seating, and an exercise-equipment aisle. They help orient visitors but do not establish a continuous route, ramp slope, lift availability or operation, transfer support, toilets or changing facilities. Capture dates and current layouts are unknown. Images remain on the YMCA website; no reuse licence was found.

title: Indoor pool edges, decks and splash features
description: Eight images were inspected; four useful orientation views show the lap-pool edges and decks from different angles and the warm-water play area with rails, bench seating and overhead water jets. Other images are swimming or slide close-ups, including outdoor attractions, and should not be mistaken for indoor access views. Some photographs contain visitors. Capture dates, current configurations, lift provision, transfer assistance, locker-room routes, thresholds and toilets remain unknown. Images stay with Silverlake; no reuse licence was found.

title: Pool deck, connecting doors and gym panoramas
description: Two original panoramas embedded on Bayley’s virtual-tour page were inspected through all six image faces each. The pool view shows tiled deck surfaces, pool-edge rails/ladders, glass doors to the adjoining exercise area and chairs beyond the glass. The gym view shows equipment aisles, a lever-handled door, benches and a drinking fountain. Panorama metadata says September 13, 2022; capture dates and current conditions are unconfirmed. The images do not establish lift availability, transfer help, doorway clearances, a continuous entrance route, track access or toilet/changing arrangements. Only the pool and fitness-center scenes were reviewed. Original panoramic stitching and a black floor patch remain as published. No reuse licence was found; imagery stays with its publisher.
publisher: Bayley · panoramas hosted by Mount St. Joseph University
documentDate: Panorama metadata September 13, 2022; capture dates unconfirmed

title: Access vehicle boarding ramp in 2024
description: One operator photograph in the April 10, 2024 announcement shows an Access vehicle with open doors and a deployed ramp, yellow edge markings, a wheelchair user on the ramp and a staff member inside. The lower end of the ramp is outside the frame. This is historical orientation for that vehicle, not evidence of the current fleet, the vehicle assigned to a trip, ramp slope or capacity, securement procedures, or MetroNow! equipment. Capture date is unconfirmed. The image remains with Metro; no reuse licence was found.
documentDate: April 10, 2024 publication; photo capture date unconfirmed

title: Ramp-to-ground connection and vehicle interior
description: Three operator photographs show a ramp meeting asphalt with yellow edge markings, another closer view of ramp boarding, and a vehicle interior with seats, rails, a walker and yellow step-edge markings. People appear in the original photographs. These are orientation views of pictured vehicles, not proof of today’s fleet, a particular trip’s equipment, ramp capacity, transfer help or a continuous pavement-to-seat route. The vehicle illustration on the page is excluded. Images remain with Metro; no reuse licence was found.
documentDate: Photo capture dates and current conditions unconfirmed

title: Bond Hill and Roselawn zone orientation map
description: One official map shows the Bond Hill/Roselawn service-area shape and named destinations. This is a map, not a photograph or a measured access route. It cannot establish pickup curb conditions or precise address eligibility. The page’s launched-zone heading and older future-tense FAQ differ; enter both trip addresses in the app or phone Metro before relying on the map. Original graphic remains with Metro.
documentDate: Map publication/capture date unconfirmed; file path contains July 2026

title: Mason entrance canopy and parking frontage
description: One official frontage photograph shows glass entrance doors beneath a canopy, nearby accessible-parking signs and striped parking areas, planters and merchandise along the frontage, and stairs at the left. A grand-opening banner names August 20, 2025; the photograph’s capture date is unknown. Door operation, thresholds, parking-to-door gradients and an uninterrupted step-free route are not established. Original image remains with DLM; no reuse licence was found.
documentDate: Photo capture dates and current conditions unconfirmed

title: Mason Culinary Center seating and doorway views
description: Five useful views in the Mason gallery show tables with separate chairs, an aisle between table groups, a long counter with tall backless stools, ceiling lighting and large windows, and glass double doors with vertical pull handles. The six-image Mason gallery was inspected; a decorative glassware close-up adds no route information. Select the Mason location on the original page; Washington Square has a separate gallery. The images do not show the route to the mezzanine, an elevator, door controls or toilet facilities, and do not establish clearances or current layouts. No reuse licence was found.
documentDate: Photo capture dates and current conditions unconfirmed

title: CRC lockers, track and exercise-room orientation
description: Four facility photographs were inspected for orientation: a locker aisle with combination locks and an accessibility symbol on one locker, an indoor track with railings and an opening into the track area, a fitness area with equipment aisles, and a mirrored studio with a barre and large windows. People appear in some original views. These do not establish a locker’s usable dimensions, elevator routes, entrance controls, changing-room equipment, lighting adjustments or quiet conditions. A swimmer close-up is excluded. Original photographs stay with UC; no reuse licence was found.
documentDate: Photo capture dates and current conditions unconfirmed

title: Leisure pool, lap-pool deck and hot-tub steps
description: Three photographs show the lap-pool deck and lanes, the leisure-pool water channels and railed shallow entry area, and a raised hot tub with external steps and handrails. The hot-tub steps are a visible feature of that pictured approach; the images do not establish an alternative entry, an operating lift, transfer help or a continuous changing-room-to-water route.
